svg.text: Why redistributing the Q intensity FLATTENS the 600–630 slope
one dominant Q origin, sitting just past our window edge
the same intensity split across four bands, spread to the blue
The window is narrow and sits on a FLANK, so its slope reports the height of the nearest peak — not the total pigment.
Schematic; band positions for the degraded form are illustrative. Modelled slope ratio 4.8× — measured 4.5× (green 0.0547, brown 0.0121).
